in_hebrew.name: Terra
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Terra הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Latin word 'terra', meaning earth or land. In Christian tradition, Terra represents the physical world and is often used as a symbol of creation and stability.
